n02.roman: Mission: Chakravyuh. Yuddh ka terahva din. Dronacharya ne sena ko pahiye jaisi gol vyuh-rachna mein sajaaya.

n03.roman: Player: Arjun aur Subhadra ka beta, Abhimanyu. Par us din Arjun door, Samshaptakon se lad rahe the.

n04.roman: Ab twist! Katha kehti hai: Abhimanyu ne maa ke garbh mein hi — vyuh mein ghusne ka tareeka sun liya tha. Par bahar nikalne ka nahi!

n05.roman: Yaani game mein: entry khuli, exit lock! Aur peeche aane waale Pandavon ko Jayadrath ne rok diya.

n06.roman: Abhimanyu andar akela reh gaya. Phir bhi uski himmat uski umar se kahin badi nikli.

n07.roman: Toh is mission ka sabak? Andar jaane se pehle, bahar aane ka raasta bhi seekho!
